resources.string: Could not take a screenshot. Try again in a moment.
Google app with Lens is required. Opening store…
Screen sharing could not be started. Please try again.

1. Add the app to Smart Sidebar (Settings → Smart Sidebar → customize).
2. Pin/lock the app in recents so ColorOS keeps it running.
3. Start screen sharing for this session. A sidebar tap captures the screen and opens its translation in Google Lens automatically.
4. Opening the app's icon from the home screen or app drawer shows this settings page.
Screen sharing permission is requested for each session. Screenshots open directly in Google Lens Translate.
